# Arcadier, Biggie & Wood, PLLC

> > AV-rated law firm in Melbourne, Florida providing comprehensive legal services across corporate, litigation, employment, family, immigration, and estate planning practice areas.

Arcadier, Biggie & Wood, PLLC is a full-service law firm based in Melbourne, Florida, with experienced attorneys recognized by Martindale-Hubbell and AVVO ratings. The firm serves clients throughout Brevard County and the greater Melbourne area with expertise spanning business law, bankruptcy, employment law, family law, immigration, and estate planning.
